maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from fund administration outsourcing and subscription financial software, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private asset managers, banks, insurers and health plans; fees paid by private financial firms, with health plan work a smaller part.

serial_acquirer.reason: Long record of acquisitions over 25 years building its fund administration, wealth, and healthcare software portfolio.

mission_critical.reason: Fund accounting, transfer agency and portfolio systems are core operations for asset managers; switching needs migration and carries regulatory risk.
